trait.vril.swift_strong.name: Swift & Strong
trait.vril.swift_strong.desc: You move faster and hit harder than normal.
trait.vril.poor_swimmer.name: Poor Swimmer
trait.vril.poor_swimmer.desc: Your swim speed is incredibly slow.
trait.vril.short_breath.name: Short Breath
trait.vril.short_breath.desc: Your air runs out far faster than normal when your head is underwater.
trait.vril.towering.name: Towering
trait.vril.towering.desc: You stand one block taller, which lets you step up higher. Your reach is slightly longer to make up for the height.
